verdict.rationale: Tilled documents closing a batch via API so transactions settle at close or end of shift "for easier reconciliation". It also offers webhooks for real-time event notifications, payout-speed views in the Dashboard, and a white-labelable "reporting console". These are building blocks for automated reconciliation, but none of them is an actual settlement or balance reporting feed. Missing for 10: settlement and balance reports per seller, rolled-up platform-level reports, file exports (e.g., CSV/SFTP) or reporting APIs, scheduled report delivery, and any independent corroboration.
